title: Roguelike Celebration 2026 - Saturday
description:
Celebrate the rich history and inspiring future of roguelikes and all things procedural generation inspired with streamed talks and more in our own custom-built roguelike social space!

Roguelike games have been part of gaming culture for over 30 years and they have a deep and special place in our hearts. Over the last ten years hundreds of roguelike and proc gen community members have gotten together to celebrate these games and their rich history, as well as the broader word of procedural generation as it relates to art, game design, academia, biology... really anything that makes someone excited enough to talk about it!

We love getting together and celebrating - so we're once again holding a two day conference to get as many likeminded creative individuals as we can into one virtual place. All you’ll need to attend Roguelike Celebration is a web browser!

Ticket access gets you additional access to our custom social space! Speaker Q&A, breakout rooms, and unconferencing happen exclusively in the social space. Tickets are pay-what-you can on Tito: https://ti.to/roguelike-celebration/roguelike-celebration-2026

Full schedule and speaker information is now available on our website: https://www.roguelike.club/event2026.html
